title: What is the hub built as?
context: A small app with a nicer, messaging-style interface. Crux today is no-dependency Node scripts and static pages, and two of your projects settled on no bundler for front-end builds.

options.name: Local Node server, browser tab
options.summary: A no-dependency Node server hosting the agents and the board, serving a plain-module web page with live updates.
options.sketch: <svg viewBox='0 0 320 180'><rect x='10' y='15' width='300' height='150' rx='8' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.2' stroke='currentColor'/><rect x='10' y='15' width='300' height='22' rx='8' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.5'/><text x='160' y='31' font-size='11' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>localhost tab</text><rect x='25' y='50' width='270' height='100' rx='6' fill='var(--accent)' fill-opacity='0.85' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='160' y='104' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Crux hub page</text></svg>
pros: Fastest to build; fits the no-bundler convention
cons: Feels like a web page, not an app

options.name: Tauri around the same page
options.summary: The Node server as a sidecar, wrapped in a small native window with tray icon and notifications.
options.sketch: <svg viewBox='0 0 320 180'><rect x='10' y='15' width='300' height='150' rx='8' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.2' stroke='currentColor'/><rect x='25' y='40' width='270' height='110' rx='6' fill='var(--accent)' fill-opacity='0.85' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='160' y='99' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Crux hub page</text><circle cx='290' cy='27' r='5' fill='var(--warn)'/><text x='50' y='32' font-size='11' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Crux</text></svg>
pros: A real small app: tray, notifications, starts at login

options.name: Electron
options.summary: A native window with Node built in.
options.sketch: <svg viewBox='0 0 320 180'><rect x='10' y='15' width='300' height='150' rx='8' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.2' stroke='currentColor'/><rect x='25' y='40' width='270' height='110' rx='6' fill='var(--accent)' fill-opacity='0.85' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='160' y='99' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Crux hub page</text><text x='50' y='32' font-size='11' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Crux</text><text x='250' y='32' font-size='11' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Node inside</text></svg>

recommendation: Build it as a local server and page first (that is all of A), then wrap it in Tauri for the small-app feel; nothing in A is thrown away.

settles.value: no-dependency Node server and plain-module page, wrapped in Tauri
